pluss::subsp::stats::ts::AdfOptions¶

Options of ts::adf_test.

AdfOptions chooses the deterministic terms and the augmentation of the test regression.

Fields¶

Field

Type

Default

Meaning

lags

std::int64_t

0

Lagged changes added to absorb short-run dynamics (the ‘augmented’ part); each uses up an observation.

model

ts::AdfModel

ARD

AR: no deterministic term. ARD: a constant. TS: a constant and a linear trend.

alpha

double

0.05

Significance level of the critical value and of reject.

Guidance¶

The defaults are a sensible starting point; change a field only for the reason its row gives.
